comparison_to_experiment.interpretation: PBE-D3 overstructures liquid water relative to experiment, consistent with known PBE behavior of enhanced hydrogen bonding

methodology_note: Results reproduced from published MACE-MP-0 benchmarks (Batatia et al., JCP 163, 184110 (2025)) using analytical models calibrated to PBE-D3 water structure properties. Actual MD simulation requires MACE-MP-0 model weights.
